status: proposed by Claude; release thresholds need Felipe's approval (PARK: product review and metrics)
scope: Deterministic candidate stage only (routes ShipLock selects for reasoning). No model is called; model-stage precision and recall need an approved paid run.

definitions.positives: labels with verdict vulnerable (both labelers agree)
definitions.negatives: labels with verdict benign (both labelers agree)
definitions.contested: reported separately, never counted as positive or negative
definitions.unobserved: labeled routes ShipLock's route inventory did not find at all (a coverage failure, reported, never counted as correct)

thisSetCanSupport: Directional reading only: 1 agreed positive and 16 agreed negatives are below minimumPositives and minimumNegatives, so no pass or fail is declared from this set.
